decisive_failure: originality: No substantive novelty vs prior art demonstrated, by authors' own admission. Upper bound 126 is direct instantiation of textbook pencil-counting (hyperplane/plane pencil over fixed point) using classical m2(2,5)=6 (conic/oval) to get m2(3,5)<=26 (which equals the known ovoid optimum 26) to get 126. This general lemma appears in Hirschfeld/Thas textbooks; applying it to (4,5) is parameter substitution, not a new bound. DRAFT Sec.5 states 'upper bound 126 is elementary and almost certainly weaker than published specialized bounds (Hill/Pellegrino/Thas-type)' and that offline comparison to Hirschfeld-Thas-Davydov m2 tables was impossible. Lower bound 51 is an explicit heuristic witness with no record claim: Sec.5 states 'we make no claim that it beats the literature'. Topic fallback required L matching/beating best Hill/ovoid/quantum-derived construction AND U' below best prior analytic bound with solver certificate; DRAFT meets neither (no ILP/SAT log, no literature comparison, no PGL stabilizer/canonical form). Nearest priors from topic.json (PG(4,3) max 20 classification arXiv:1203.0986; PG(4,4) max 41 DOI:10.1023/A:1008389013117; AG(4,4) max 40 unique DOI:10.1023/A:1024144223076; Guan et al. quantum caps in PG(4,5) DOI:10.1088/1742-6596/1948/1/012152; Bartoli-Davydov t2 tables arXiv:1610.09656) show (4,5) general-cap maximum is the open stratum but also that restricted quantum-subfamily enumerations and t2 small-cap tables exist; DRAFT provides no substantive comparison showing 51 exceeds known general-cap constructions or that 126 improves any analytic bound. Offline failed webfetch does not establish priority. Hence interval as claimed is at best a replayable re-derivation, not an original contribution. value: Not independently worth finding later. Exact-census target m2(4,5)=K* with (K*+1)-unsatisfiability certificate was not achieved (correctly disclaimed). Residual interval [51,126] has gap 75, is wide, and by authors' admission is likely strictly weaker than published tables/bounds on both sides, so it does not tighten the (4,5) benchmark as fallback required. Upper side is textbook restatement + mere parameter substitution (standard counting chain). Lower side is a single greedy/perturbation witness (49-51 spread, best 51 from seed 2, 300k trials with no improvement correctly labelled as proving nothing) with hyperplane spectrum but no stabilizer, canonical form, weight distribution, structural construction (quadric/linear-code family), or isomorphism analysis: i.e. an unexplained enumeration. Completeness (maximal by inclusion) does not imply optimality. No coding/quantum consequence beyond elementary [51,46,>=4]_5 covering-radius-2 translation (motivation only). Even if the 51 coordinate set were new as an object, a solitary non-record heuristic cap plus a weak textbook upper bound without classification or gap closure is not a citable extremal result updating m2 tables or quantum-code databases. REPAIRABLE is inapplicable…

problem_statement: Determine m2(4,5), the exact maximum cardinality of a cap (set of points, no three collinear) in PG(4,5). PG(4,5) has (5^5-1)/(5-1)=781 points; each line has 6 points; number of lines is 781*156/6=20306 (156 lines through each point). Deliver: (a) the exact integer m2(4,5); (b) one extremal K-cap with K=m2(4,5) given by explicit normalized homogeneous coordinates in GF(5)^5 up to PGL(5,5) equivalence with canonical invariants; (c) exact no-three-collinear verification tables enumerating all 20306 lines and certifying each contains at most 2 witness points, plus a separate replayable solver optimality log proving no (K+1)-cap exists under symmetry-breaking.
